name: Web Release
outcome: The repository has a verified, repository-specific web release process that prepares and validates a release, promotes it through pull requests, deploys it to Vercel Production, and proves the live result.
constraints: Preserve the existing Web Release sequence, repository security policy, and branch protections.
Use only release branches, version commands, validation workflows, deployment settings, and smoke checks verified in the repository or explicitly supplied by its owner.
Never write deployment credentials to repository files or run a production release while applying this Blueprint.
Do not declare success until the proposed repository configuration and validation workflow pass their real pull-request checks.

criteria: A release pull request can be prepared with the repository's verified version rules.
The repository-owned validation workflow can be dispatched for the release pull request and must pass before merge.
The validated release pull request can merge into the configured default branch without weakening repository policy.
The default branch can be promoted through a pull request to the configured release branch, or promotion is a verified no-op for a single-branch release.
The configured release branch can deploy to Vercel Production using Kody-managed secrets rather than repository files.
The configured production URL and smoke command prove the deployed release is live when those checks are required.
